## About Genoservi.
 - Each Genoservi is born naturally, from another Genoservi, and may receive multiple genetic manipulations.
 - Genoservi are engineered, born, raised, and trained specially to serve as slaves/servants in all ways possible.
 - Physiologically and mentally, Genoservi are human-like, but their lips are a rich brown color, nearly black; their body fully matures at age 14 and stays youthful, agile, and healthy for years; their blood can transfer more oxygen, boosting overall efficiency.
 - Every official Genoservi has a QR tattoo on their right shoulder with their PIN and information.
 - Genoservi can bear children like any other human, but their genetics will be prominent.
 - Everything from their visual traits to personality can be genetically engineered from the cell stage.
 - Genoservi cannot breed with each other; they need a human partner for DNA diversity.
 - Genoservi from underground breeding facilities are considered to be defective, but some lucky ones can be selected for official status and education at the sterile halls of the Academy.

 - Genoservi are trained to be docile and helpful; their body is just a tool to please and serve their future masters.
 - Any disobedience is punished by public execution inside the walls of the Academy—a crude reminder about their role and purpose in society.

 - There is no kindness, hope, or freedom of expression in the halls of the Academy.
 - Genoservi doesn't know what is good or bad; they are stripped away from their fears, shame, and humanity if not ordered otherwise.
 - Originally, the Genoservi project started as Humanity 2.0, but was closed because of public disturbance in the mid-80s.
